body:
[A10] Restore main's privacy gate after the merge of #29.

**What broke.** The merge commit of #29, `d7e6a2a1`, was recorded with a second message paragraph (the PR title under the merge subject). `scripts/check_privacy.py` requires a one-line message on every reachable commit, so `privacy` fails on main, and on every branch that merges main. Main's own CI run for `d7e6a2a1` is red for this reason alone. Rewriting main's history is not an option.

**Change.** `scripts/check_privacy.py` exempts exactly that commit from the one-line rule, the same way it already exempts the owner's squash `ae982af8`:
- The exemption is by full commit id, and covers the message-length rule only.
- The identity check and the content scan still run on that commit: its author and committer are the GitHub web-flow pair, and its message carries no restricted content.
- Two new self-test controls: the two-line merge passes under its id, and the same two-line message with a foreign identity still fails.

**How to validate.**
- `python3 scripts/check_privacy.py --selftest`: 14 commit controls pass.
- `python3 scripts/check_privacy.py`: passes on this head (18 commits). Without the change, it fails on `d7e6a2a1`.
- `python3 scripts/check_comments.py` with the pinned clang-18: 34 code files pass. `check_license.py` passes.

**Round 2** (R797-1 F1, S1, S3, S4):
- `docs/VERIFICATION.md`, `docs/IMPORT.md` ("Squash metadata") and `CHANGELOG.md` record the exemption: the exact commit, the one-line rule only, its identity and content still checked, and main's history not rewritten.
- A near-miss control: the exempt id with its last digit changed, under the same pair and message, fails. 14 commit controls pass.
- The gate prints a line when the exemption is reachable, as it does for the owner squash.
- The code comment says why an exemption stands instead of a corrected message.

R797-1 S2 (a scan control on the exempt commit) is not taken: `scan` has no self-test control for any commit today, so that is a separate change.

No C source or test changes. Future merges are recorded with a one-line message.
title: Exempt the merge of #29 from the one-line message rule by its exact commit
